mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN source_type LIKE 'AUTO%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS autoCount, SUM(CASE WHEN source_type = 'MANUAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manualCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeCount, IFNULL(SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(IFNULL(content, '')) + CHAR_LENGTH(IFNULL(summary, ''))), 0) AS contentChars, SUM(CASE WHEN file_url IS NOT NULL AND file_url <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fileCount, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(view_count, 0)), 0) AS viewTotal FROM ${table}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS docCount, SUM(CASE WHEN source_type LIKE 'AUTO%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS autoCount FROM ${table} WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate
SELECT source_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ${table} GROUP BY source_type ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT category AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ${table} GROUP BY category ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT TABLE_NAME AS tableName, TABLE_ROWS AS tableRows, IFNULL(DATA_LENGTH, 0) AS dataLength, IFNULL(INDEX_LENGTH, 0) AS indexLength, IFNULL(DATA_LENGTH, 0) + IFNULL(INDEX_LENGTH, 0) AS totalBytes FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN #{t} ORDER BY totalBytes DESC
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA AS schemaName, COUNT(*) AS tableCount, IFNULL(SUM(DATA_LENGTH), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(INDEX_LENGTH), 0) AS totalBytes FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = #{schema}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS callCount, IFNULL(AVG(hit_count), 0) AS kbHitAvg, SUM(CASE WHEN hit_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hitCalls, SUM(CASE WHEN invoke_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCalls FROM ai_invoke_log WHERE invoke_time >= #{since}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS scoredCount, IFNULL(AVG(ai_score), 0) AS aiAvg, SUM(CASE WHEN score IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradedCount, IFNULL(AVG(CASE WHEN score IS NOT NULL THEN ABS(ai_score - score) END), NULL) AS avgAbsDiff, SUM(CASE WHEN ai_status = '已完成' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS doneCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ai_status = '失败' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount FROM homework_submission WHERE ai_scored_at >= #{since}
SELECT ai_report FROM homework_submission WHERE ai_scored_at >= #{since} AND ai_report IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ai_scored_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_access_log (endpoint, method, api_group, username, role_scope, status, duration_ms) VALUES (#{endpoint}, #{method}, #{apiGroup}, #{username}, #{roleScope}, #{status}, #{durationMs})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 1), 0) AS avgDurationMs, SUM(CASE WHEN status < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS okCalls, SUM(CASE WHEN status >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCalls, COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint) AS endpointCount, COUNT(DISTINCT username) AS userCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(access_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayCalls FROM api_access_log WHERE access_time >= #{since}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(access_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS calls, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 1), 0) AS avgDurationMs, SUM(CASE WHEN status >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCalls FROM api_access_log WHERE access_time >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(access_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate
SELECT WEEKDAY(access_time) AS weekday, HOUR(access_time) AS hourOfDay, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM api_access_log WHERE access_time >= #{since} GROUP BY WEEKDAY(access_time), HOUR(access_time)

SELECT endpoint AS endpoint, method AS method, api_group AS apiGroup, COUNT(*) AS calls, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 1), 0) AS avgDurationMs, SUM(CASE WHEN status >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCalls FROM api_access_log WHERE access_time >= #{since} GROUP BY endpoint, method, api_group ORDER BY calls DESC, avgDurationMs DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT api_group AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM api_access_log WHERE access_time >= #{since} GROUP BY api_group ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT IFNULL(role_scope, 'ANON') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM api_access_log WHERE access_time >= #{since} GROUP BY IFNULL(role_scope, 'ANON') ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT caller_scope AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ai_invoke_log WHERE invoke_time >= #{since} GROUP BY caller_scope ORDER BY value DESC
